text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, who do you think's gonna win
today's 'Mile CS'?”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's gotta be Bamboo Memory, right?!
She's basically the current sprint champion!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
How's Helios doing? She's in super top form!
There's even rumors she could be the next Sprint Queen... Though "queen" isn't really her vibe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew,
things are really heating up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Miracle, Ruby?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I'm starting to get excited too!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Just as expected of a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You really surprised me, though!
I had no idea you two were coming to watch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Miracle debuts this year, right? Coming to watch for race reference, maybe?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I believe this distance
is where my legs can shine the most.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Because I'm sure that someday, I want to run in this race too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Miracle, you're crazy fast!
Totally cliché way of putting it, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll achieve amazing results!
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Of course,
I came to cheer on Helios too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
They'll definitely be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"So... don't tell me
you're here to cheer on Helios too, Ruby!?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am...—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Mother.
I am... deeply, truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Unable to run in either the Shuka Sho or the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, I broke my own oath... and brought dishonor upon my family's name."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
This is entirely due to my own inadequacy.
...I offer you my deepest apologies.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, there is still the Arima Kinen...
and prestigious races like the Tenno Sho once you advance to the Senior class."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Please, give me another chance. Next time, I will seize a victory worthy of our family line—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: And you?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It would be best to take on the sprint division.
Please do so starting from the Senior year.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please wait! It is true that I have yet to achieve
any glorious results...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, to show results worthy of the kindness I've received...
I must walk the path
that everyone expects of me!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...To everyone who raised me to where I am today,
even though in my childhood my poor leg conformation led them to believe I could never run."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, I will deliver the victory you desire.
So from now on as well—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Even so,
that is your only path forward."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Watch the Mile CS. And there,
gaze steadfastly upon your own path."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I am terribly, terribly sorry—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...!
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I had some personal matters to attend to,
which is why I'm here today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, isn't it about time for the paddock?
Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mira, Palmer, and Milady!! Whoa, you guys came!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhhhh!!
Super!! Hype!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, looks like you're fired up?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"How're ya feeling, Helios?
What's on your mind right now?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Bam-cham.
No, Bamboo."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"No more messing around.
I'm going all out for this race!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome!
Then I'll listen!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios!
What are you looking to get out of this race!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Love!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah... Love!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is that, seriously!
That's crazy hype!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ain't that what I just said, dammit?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios!!
We can expect a super passionate showdown, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
I'm gonna hit 'em with all my love!!
